Assigned Use: Main microcontrollers; one handles environmental sensors and the other handles motion and additional sensor inputs, processes readings, and communicates wirelessly.
Measures temperature, humidity, atmospheric pressure, and gas-resistance-based air-quality readings.
Measures acceleration, angular velocity, movement, tilt, and vibration.
Measures distance using ultrasonic waves for spatial and proximity-related monitoring.
Measures airflow and helps identify unusual changes in air movement.
Detects water leakage at monitored locations and supplies readings to the controller.
Central hardware platform for mounting and electrically connecting the system components.
Receives wireless alerts from AirDrop and provides notifications to the user.
